description: This file is a code-behind for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling UI events and server transfers within the online examination system's admin panel.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue page, managing navigation and session state for the course queue in the admin system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the initial page load, currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the home button, transfers control to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the profile button, currently no implementation.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the leaderboard button, transfers to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the logout button, transfers to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection changes in the GridView, updates session and transfers to the current course queue page.
